primary_document_title: Agenda Nacional para a Inteligência Artificial (ANIA), January 2026
source_notes: Focal subject of the v2 report. ANIA is Action #20 of the broader EDN; ARTE (Decree-Law 96/2025) is the operational lead.

primary_document_title: Argentina Digital Agenda (Anexo 5628461), 2018
source_notes: 2018 Digital Agenda is broader-than-AI and now stale; no AI-specific strategy.

primary_document_title: National AI Plan and APS AI Plan, November 2025
source_notes: 3-document stack: BCA Accelerating (Jun 2025) and DISR National AI Plan and Finance/DTA/APSC APS AI Plan. Paired with New Zealand in the v2 report's chosen-eight convention.

primary_document_title: Plano Brasileiro de IA (PBIA), IA para o Bem de Todos, 2024-2028
source_notes: 117-institution participatory governance for design. Bill 2338/23 still pending in Congress.

primary_document_title: State Council Opinion on AI+ Action, August 2025
source_notes: Primary anchor is the State Council AI+ Opinion (Aug 2025). Generative AI Interim Measures (2023) plus algorithmic recommendation regulation plus October 2025 Cybersecurity Law amendment are binding background statutes referenced in eth_ai_act_or_equivalent scoring.

primary_document_title: Egypt National AI Strategy, Second Edition, 2025-2030
source_notes: NCAI is single central authority under MCIT. The 26% marginal-workforce KPI is the only quantified marginal-population commitment in the corpus.

primary_document_title: AI 4.0 Programme (TEM), 2022
source_notes: Twin-transition plus carbon-handprint framing originator. EU AI Act anchored.

primary_document_title: Stratégie nationale 2024 / Rapport Aghion-Bouverot, March 2024
source_notes: Independent commission credibility through Aghion-Bouverot. Humanism pillar first; AI Action Summit host February 2025.

primary_document_title: AI Strategy 2020 Update and BMBF Aktionsplan 2023
source_notes: Two-document stack: federal AI Strategy (2020 update) plus BMBF Aktionsplan (2023). Mitbestimmung plus AI Observatory for Work and Society for worker voice.

primary_document_title: IndiaAI Mission, Cabinet approval 7 March 2024
source_notes: Cabinet-approved with no parliamentary statute (structural fragility). India AI Governance Guidelines (MeitY 2025) with seven Sutras. Largest cohesion ambition in the corpus.

primary_document_title: Italian Strategy for AI 2024-2026, June 2024
source_notes: AGID issuing; Foundation under PM Office planned but not yet stood up. Mezzogiorno regional focus is the distinctive cohesion vector.

primary_document_title: AI Strategy 2022 and AI Basic Plan (Dec 2025, under Act No. 53/2025)
source_notes: Only country in the corpus with a dedicated AI Act statute (Act No. 53/2025). AI Strategy 2022 carries the quantified per-cohort education targets; AI Basic Plan operationalises them.

primary_document_title: Kenya AI Strategy 2025-2030
source_notes: Strong multi-stakeholder consultation (town halls; PWD inclusion KPIs with United Disabled Persons of Kenya as convenor). Africa's AI hub ambition.

primary_document_title: New Zealand AI Strategy, July 2025
source_notes: Paired with Australia in the v2 report's chosen-eight convention. Treaty of Waitangi embedded; OECD AI Principles adopted in explicit rejection of an AI-Act-equivalent. Light-touch principles-based.

primary_document_title: Nigeria National AI Strategy, 19 September 2025
source_notes: 3MTT (3 million tech talent in 4 years) is the corpus's largest quantified workforce target. Decoloniality named as ethical principle; brain-drain (japa) flagged candidly.

primary_document_title: Qatar Digital Agenda 2030
source_notes: Not-AI-specific document (Digital Agenda 2030 with an AI section). Top-down royal-court coordination. Most scores reflect document scope, not country potential.

primary_document_title: National AI Strategy 2.0 (NAIS 2.0), December 2023
source_notes: Source of the AI Verify open-source toolkit cited as scope-exception in the v2 report (Recommendation 3). AI Verify Foundation has 90+ corporate members.

primary_document_title: South Africa AI Planning (discussion draft), October 2023
source_notes: Discussion-draft status (October 2023), not yet binding. AIISA targets 11 AI Hubs/Centres at universities by 2025 (distributed model). NDP 2030 anchor.

primary_document_title: Estrategia de Inteligencia Artificial 2024
source_notes: Tabla 6 per-Palanca budget granularity is the gold standard alongside Brazil PBIA. ALIA state-funded LLM family in castellano plus four co-official languages plus Ibéricos PT-ES subfamily proposal.

primary_document_title: Sweden AI Strategy and Action Plan annex, 2026
source_notes: ATR (Algorithmic Transparency Register) named. Nordic worker-voice strength.

primary_document_title: UAE National Strategy for AI 2031, October 2018
source_notes: First country globally with a Minister of AI (HE Omar Sultan Al Olama). Falcon (TII) operational sovereign LLM with open-source release. AI Centennial 2071 long-horizon framing.

primary_document_title: AI Opportunities Action Plan (Jan 2025) and AI Playbook (Feb 2025)
source_notes: Two-document stack: AP (50 recommendations, all accepted by government per CP 1242) plus Playbook (5-tier civil-servant segmentation). AISI first AI Safety Institute globally. ATRS mandatory in-scope for public sector. Pro-innovation principles plus sector regulators (NOT EU AI Act path).

primary_document_title: America's AI Action Plan, Winning the Race, July 2025
source_notes: Executive Order 14179 anchored; CAIOC cross-agency body; partisan single-administration framing. DEI references actively removed from NIST AI RMF and federal procurement guidance. Open-source/open-weight AI explicitly framed as strategic priority. URL points to Executive Order 14179 (the legal anchor); the AI Action Plan PDF itself is on whitehouse.gov but the canonical URL needs verification.
